''''Blueberries'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|250}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

==Position==
Note that some small paintings hang higher or lower on the wall than others.
